en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city square with mid‑20th‑century cars. On the right stands a large domed former mosque with a cross on top and a spacious paved square in front, containing a tall Baroque plague column or monument with sculptures. On the left is a long, ornate classical building lining a tree‑planted street. The reverse side shows printed multilingual captions identifying the scene, handwritten Hungarian text, and a Hungarian postage stamp.
